class.name: IfcCartesianPoint
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A point defined by its coordinates in a two or three dimensional rectangular Cartesian coordinate system, or in a two dimensional parameter space. The entity is defined in a two or three dimensional space. The derived attribute Dim has been added (see also note at IfcGeometricRepresentationItem ). The WR1 was added to constrain the usage of IfcCartesianPoint

members.member: The first, second, and third coordinate of the point location. If placed in a two or three dimensional rectangular Cartesian coordinate system, Coordinates[1] is the X coordinate, Coordinates[2] is the Y coordinate, and Coordinates[3] is the Z coordinate.
